title: qwen-chat module diagram
description: The tool's modules and how they depend on each other.

components.name: qwen-chat sources
components.responsibility: The whole tool, compiled into one binary.

components.name: Command line and chat (main.rs)
components.responsibility: Parses options, picks the weights, runs the chat loop or one question, keeps the history and fits each message into the context, prints replies and stops them on Ctrl-C.

components.name: Prompt format (prompt.rs)
components.responsibility: Qwen3.5 ChatML text for the system message, each user turn and a rebuilt conversation, with thinking on or off; splits streamed text into reasoning and answer.

components.name: Engine (engine.rs)
components.responsibility: Loads the model, owns the llama.cpp context and sampler, feeds tokens in batches and streams sampled text as valid UTF-8.

components.name: Weights (download.rs)
components.responsibility: Chooses the cache folder, downloads the pinned file with resume and retries, and checks its SHA-256.

components.name: llama.cpp
components.responsibility: Model loading and inference, through the llama-cpp-2 crate.

relationships.description: Builds the text it feeds and splits each reply.
